technique_name: Compare and contrast the differences between a disk and tape backup.
description: The main difference between disk and tape backup is in the type of storage medium that each system uses. Disk backups use hard drives to store information, while tapes use magnetic tape reels. Disk backups represent a more modern storage medium, as they are quicker and more efficient than tape storage.
